usedFor: Cobot holds coworking bookings, and Slack tells your team about each one through “Send Message”.

bestTemplate.name: “Booking Created” in Cobot, then “Send Message” in Slack
bestTemplate.why: Each new Cobot booking posts to a Slack channel, so the front desk knows who is coming.

watchOut: An automation's post to a Slack channel waits for your approval today, so “Send Message” is not instant.
